name: Mage Armor, Adjustable
body:
School conjuration, varies by effect; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will (negates, harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell grants a +4 armor bonus to the recipient’s AC and is a force effect that applies to incorporeal attacks as mage armor with the additional benefit that the caster may add a special ability to the armor that are incremental with armor bonuses (abilities that have a flat gold piece cost may not be added to the effects of this spell).

The caster may add a +1 bonus ability to the mage armor and this bonus increases by +1 at 13th, 16th, and 19th levels.

Note:

This spell lists two different schools. The general rules regarding this issue are as follows:

If a school is listed, a specialist wizard may cast the spell as one of his daily bonus spells at the level indicated.
The Spell Focus feat does grant the effective DC bonus for the spell if one of the schools listed includes the focus feat chosen.
If one of the schools listed is an opposition school, the caster must pay the price of two spell slots to prepare the spell.
If both schools listed encompasses the caster’s school of specialization and his school of opposition then the spell may be used to occupy the bonus spell slot, but an additional slot must be used as well.

This spell is built upon the standard mage armor spell. As a result the benefits of these spells do not stack with each other. If the spell caster casts another mage armor (or mage armor variant spell) while one is currently active, the new spell replaces the active spell and any effects from the previous spell are ended immediately. Any spell that grants a force-based armor bonus is considered a mage armor (or variant) spell for purposes of this restriction.
